racecen1.label: (What is your race? Indicate one or more races that you consider yourself to be.) First mention

racecen2.label: (What is your race? Indicate one or more races that you consider yourself to be.) Second mention

racecen3.label: (What is your race? Indicate one or more races that you consider yourself to be.) Third mention

race.label: What race do you consider yourself? RECORD VERBATIM AND CODE. CODE WITHOUT ASKING ONLY IF THERE IS NO DOUBT IN YOUR MIND.
race.notes: Prior to 2021, interviewer coded, except when asked per instructions. If planning to perform trend analysis with this variable, please consult GSS Methodological Report No. 56. RACE was replaced with RACECEN1,2,3 in 2002, but imputed for trend analysis. I

eth1.label: (From what countries or part of the world did your ancestors come?) FIRST ETHNICITY MENTIONED

eth2.label: (From what countries or part of the world did your ancestors come?) SECOND ETHNICITY MENTIONED

eth3.label: (From what countries or part of the world did your ancestors come?) THIRD ETHNICITY MENTIONED

hispanic.label: Are you Spanish, Hispanic, or Latino/Latina? IF YES: Which group are you from?
hispanic.notes: The two questions above were asked sequentially of the respondent. Hand Card A5 was given to Latino respondents and had response options 2-4 plus 'Other Hispanic, specify.'

sibs.label: How many brothers and sisters did you have? Please count those born alive, but no longer living, as well as those  alive now. Also include stepbrothers and stepsisters, and children adopted by your parents.
sibs.notes: If planning to perform trend analysis with this variable, please consult GSS Methodological Report No. 56. The response categories have been collapsed for convenience of display.

marital.label: Are you currently married, widowed, divorced, separated, or have you never been married?

widowed.label: IF CURRENTLY MARRIED, SEPARATED, OR DIVORCED: Have you ever been widowed?

divorce.label: IF CURRENTLY MARRIED OR WIDOWED: Have you ever been divorced or legally separated?

posslq.label: Which of these statements applies to you?
posslq.notes: Card A1.2a contained responses 1-4. POSSLQ and POSSLQY are used to drive certain spouse/partner skips in the replicating core.

codes.label: I AM MARRIED AND LIVING IN THE SAME HOUSEHOLD AS MY HUSBAND OR WIFE
I AM LIVING AS MARRIED AND MY PARTNER AND I TOGETHER LIVE IN THE SAME HOUSEHOLD
I HAVE A HUSBAND OR WIFE OR STEADY PARTNER, BUT WE DON'T LIVE IN THE SAME HOUSEHOLD
I DON'T HAVE A STEADY PARTNER

posslqy.label: Which of these statements applies to you? CODE ONE ONLY.
posslqy.notes: Card A1.2b contained responses 1-4. See POSSLQ.

codes.label: I AM MARRIED AND LIVING IN THE SAME HOUSEHOLD AS MY HUSBAND OR WIFE
I AM LIVING AS MARRIED AND MY PARTNER AND I TOGETHER LIVE IN THE SAME HOUSEHOLD
I HAVE A HUSBAND OR WIFE OR STEADY PARTNER, BUT WE DON'T LIVE IN THE SAME HOUSEHOLD
I DON'T HAVE A STEADY PARTNER

childs.label: How many children have you ever had? Please count all that were born alive at any time (including any you had from a previous marriage).

agekdbrn.label: How old were you when your first child was born?
agekdbrn.notes: AGEKDBRN is coded in two digits. The collapsed numbers are for convenience of display only.

major1.label: What was your major or field of study when you received your (RESPONDENT'S COLLEGE DEGREE) degree? [IF THE RESPONDENT RECEIVED MORE THAN ONE GRADUATE LEVEL DEGREE, ASK ABOUT THE HIGHEST DEGREE OBTAINED (E.G. ABOUT A Ph.D. RATHER THAN AN M.B.A). [COUNT UP

major2.label: What was your major or field of study when you received your (RESPONDENT'S COLLEGE DEGREE) degree? [IF THE RESPONDENT RECEIVED MORE THAN ONE GRADUATE LEVEL DEGREE, ASK ABOUT THE HIGHEST DEGREE OBTAINED (E.G. ABOUT A Ph.D. RATHER THAN AN M.B.A).

relig.label: What is your religious preference? Is it Protestant, Catholic, Jewish, some other religion, or no religion?

denom.label: IF PROTESTANT:   What specific denomination is that, if any? (PROBE FOR EXACT DENOMINATION)
denom.notes: RELIG, punch 5 (Other, SPECIFY), is available from NORC. DENOM, punch 60 recoded into OTHER.

codes.label: AMERICAN BAPTIST CHURCHES IN THE U.S.A.
UNITED PRESBYTERIAN CHURCH IN THE U.S.A.

other.label: IF PROTESTANT:   What specific denomination is that, if any?(PROBE FOR EXACT DENOMINATION)

codes.label: CHURCHES OF GOD (EXCEPT WITH CHRIST AND HOLINESS)

jew.label: IF JEWISH:  Do you consider yourself Orthodox, Conservative, Reform or none of these? (PROBE FOR EXACT DENOMINATION)
jew.notes: In 2008, if respondent answered RELIG=3 or OTHJEW= 1 (Yes) or 2 (Half or Part) , then JEW was asked.

reliten.label: (ASK EVERYONE WITH ANY RELIGIOUS PREFERENCE NAMED IN RELIG) Would you call yourself a strong (PREFERENCE NAMED IN RELIG) or a not very strong (PREFERENCE NAMED IN RELIG)?
reliten.notes: RELITENV and RELITENNV replace RELITEN in the 2022 GSS Cross-section web mode. This variable shows sensitivity to mode of administration. Research and interpretation done using the data should take extra care to ensure the analysis reflects actual changes in public opinion and is not unduly influenced by the change in data collection methods.

income.label: In which of these groups did your total family income, from all sources, fall last year before taxes, that is?
income.notes: Showcard D contained responses for Punches 01-12 only. INCOME is coded from the most up-to-date income variable in the given round of the GSS, currently INCOME16. If planning to perform trend analysis with this variable, please consult GSS Methodological 56.

income16.label: In which of these groups did your total family income, from all sources, fall last year? That is, before taxes.
income16.notes: Showcard A20 reads: Total income includes interest or dividends, rent, Social Security, other pension, alimony or child support, unemployment compensation, public aid (welfare), armed forces or veteran’s allotment. INCOME16 was most recently updated in 2016.

uscitzn.label: Now we would like to ask you about U.S. citizenship. Are you…
uscitzn.notes: RESPONDENT SAYS S/HE IS 'NATURALIZED,' CODE 'A U.S. CITIZEN.' USCITZNV and USCITZNNV replace USCITZN in the 2022 GSS Cross-section web mode. This variable shows sensitivity to mode of administration. Research and interpretation done using the data should take extra care to ensure the analysis reflects actual changes in public opinion and is not unduly influenced by the change in data collection methods.

codes.label: A U.S. CITIZEN BORN IN PUERTO RICO, THE U.S. VIRGIN ISLANDS, OR THE NORTHERN MARIANAS ISLANDS
BORN OUTSIDE OF THE U.S. TO PARENTS WHO WERE U.S. CITIZENS AT THAT TIME

fucitzn.label: Are you…
fucitzn.notes: FUCITZNV and FUCITZNNV replace FUCITZN in the 2022 GSS Cross-section web mode. This variable shows sensitivity to mode of administration. Research and interpretation done using the data should take extra care to ensure the analysis reflects actual changes in public opinion and is not unduly influenced by the change in data collection methods.

codes.label: PLANNING TO APPLY FOR U.S. CITIZENSHIP
NOT PLANNING TO APPLY TO U.S. CITIZENSHIP
NOT ELIGIBLE TO BECOME A U.S. CITIZEN

mnthsusa.label: How long have you lived in the United States? If less than a year, please specify the time in months. If you have lived in the United States for more than one period during your life, what is the total number of years you have lived in the United States?

yearsusa.label: How long have you lived in the United States? If less than a year, please specify the time in months. If you have lived in the United States for more than one period during your life, what is the total number of years you have lived in the United States?

othlang.label: Can you speak a language other than English [Spanish]?
othlang.notes: For those interviewed in Spanish, they were asked if they spoke a language other than Spanish.

othlang1.label: What other language(s) do you speak? First response.
othlang1.notes: English was an allowable code for those interviewed in Spanish, see OTHLANG.

othlang2.label: What other language(s) do you speak? Second response.
othlang2.notes: English was an allowable code for those interviewed in Spanish, see OTHLANG.

betrlang.label: Which language do you speak more fluently?

spklang.label: How well do you speak that language? [IF SPEAKS 2 OR MORE, ASK ONLY OF THE MOST FLUENT LANGUAGE] READ CATEGORIES

wrkstat.label: Last week were you working full time, part time, going to school, keeping house, or what?
wrkstat.notes: Card A2 contained responses for punches 1 through 7. Contents of WRKSTAT, punch 8 (Other, SPECIFY) available from NORC.

codes.label: WITH A JOB, BUT NOT AT WORK BECAUSE OF TEMPORARY ILLNESS, VACATION, STRIKE
UNEMPLOYED, LAID OFF, LOOKING FOR WORK

evwork.label: IF RETIRED, IN SCHOOL, KEEPING HOUSE, OR OTHER: Did you ever work for as long as one year?
evwork.notes: Showcard A contained responses for punches 1 through 8.

wrkslffam.label: (Do/did) you work in your own family business or farm?

whatslf2.label: How would you classify the place where you (work/worked)? Was this mainly...?

wrkgovt1.label: (Are/Were) you employed by the government? (Please consider federal, state, or local government.)

wrkgovt2.label: (Are/Were) you employed by a private employer (including non-profit organizations)?

numemps.label: Are/were you self-employed or do/did you work for someone else? [If 'Self-employed'] Do/did you have any employees? [If 'Yes'] How many employees do/did you have?
numemps.notes: If respondents answered 'Self-employed' to the first part but 'No' to the second part, they did not receive the third part of the question.

hrs1.label: IF WORKING, FULL OR PART TIME: How many hours did you work last week, at all jobs?
hrs1.notes: If planning to perform trend analysis with WRKSTAT, please consult GSS Methodological Report No. 56. The response categories have been collapsed for convenience of display. Responses greater than 89 were coded 89.

hrs2.label: IF WITH A JOB, BUT NOT AT WORK: How many hours a week do you usually work, at all jobs?
hrs2.notes: The response categories have been collapsed for convenience of display. Responses greater than 89 were coded 89.

weekswrk.label: Now I'd like to ask you about last year. In [the last year] how many weeks did you work either full-time or part-time not counting work around the house--include paid vacations and sick leave?
weekswrk.notes: WEEKSWRK is coded in two digits. The collapsed numbers above are for convenience of display only.

partfull.label: When you worked in [2019/2020], was it usually full or part time?

rincom16.label: In which of these groups did your earnings from (OCC), from all sources for [the last year] fall? That is, before taxes or other deductions.
rincom16.notes: Showcard A20 reads: Total income includes interest or dividends, rent, Social Security, other pension, alimony or child support, unemployment compensation, public aid (welfare), armed forces or veteran’s allotment RINCOME16 was most recently updated in 2016.

localnum.label: About how many people work at the location where you work? (Count part-time as well as full-time employees in all areas, departments and buildings.)
localnum.notes: Card A3 contained responses for punches 1-7.

wksub1.label: Do you (does your (SPOUSE or PARTNER) have a supervisor on (your/his/her) job to whom you are (he/she/is) directly responsible?

wksubs1.label: IF YES: Does that person have a supervisor on the job to whom he is directly responsible?

wksup1.label: In your (SPOUSE or PARTNER'S) job, (do you/does he/she) supervise anyone who is directly responsible to (you/him/her)?

wksups1.label: IF YES: Do any of those persons supervise anyone else?

vetyears.label: Have you ever been on active duty for military training or service for two consecutive months or more?  IF YES: What was your total time on active duty?
